description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal leadership role offers a competitive salary range of $85,000 - $95,000 per year, reflecting our commitment to attracting top talent. The ideal candidate will be a compassionate leader with a strong background in long-term care, passionate about delivering exceptional patient outcomes and fostering a supportive environment for both residents and staff.

As the Director of Nursing, you will be responsible for overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring compliance with state and federal regulations, and maintaining the highest standards of care. You will play a crucial role in staff development, quality improvement initiatives, and creating a positive, resident-centered culture. This is an excellent opportunity for a visionary nursing leader to make a significant impact within a dynamic healthcare setting.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience as a Director of Nursing or Assistant Director of Nursing in a skilled nursing facility
Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000 based on experience.
